author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the era of AI, we have a code fragmentation problem.   

Unless it is a well-known and well supported opensource library, it is far easier to tell my AI to "steal" bits and pieces from the package I want to reuse and embed only the code that I need directly in my project, instead of trying to import the whole package and call the API.
